question: For each IPL season, identify the top three batsmen with the highest total runs scored and the top three bowlers with the most wickets taken, excluding ‘run out’, ‘hit wicket’, and ‘retired hurt’ dismissals. In the event of ties in runs or wickets, break the tie using the smaller player ID. Then output these six players in matched positions—batsman 1 with bowler 1, batsman 2 with bowler 2, and batsman 3 with bowler 3—in ascending order of the season ID, along with each player’s total runs or wickets.
sql:
-- Final query: Top 3 batsmen and top 3 bowlers per season, matched by position
WITH batsmen AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, b.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC, b.striker ASC) as rank
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY m.season_id, b.striker
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY SUM(bs.runs_scored) DESC, b.striker ASC) <= 3
),
bowlers AS (
    SELECT m.season_id, b.bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.bowler ASC) as rank
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE w.kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY m.season_id, b.bowler
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.season_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, b.bowler ASC) <= 3
)
SELECT batsmen.season_id,
       batsmen.rank as position,
       batsmen.player_id as batsman_id,
       CAST(batsmen.total_runs AS INTEGER) as batsman_runs,
       bowlers.player_id as bowler_id,
       bowlers.total_wickets as bowler_wickets
FROM batsmen
JOIN bowlers ON batsmen.season_id = bowlers.season_id AND batsmen.rank = bowlers.rank
ORDER BY batsmen.season_id, batsmen.rank
